20261121-physics-e5-2.thinking.0: Wata mota ta bi wani sashe
20261121-physics-e5-2.s.s1.prompt: Wata mota ta bi wani sashe na babbar hanya mai sa ido kan gudu (jimillar tazara 30 km) cikin mintuna 15. Menene matsakaicin gudun motar a km a awa?
20261121-physics-e5-2.s.s1.explain: Mintuna $15$ su ne $\frac{15}{60} = 0.25$ awa ($\frac{1}{4}$ awa). Matsakaicin gudu shine $30\text{ km} \div 0.25\text{ h} = 120\text{ km/h}$.
20261121-physics-e5-2.s.s1.hint.0: Canza mintuna 15 zuwa sa'a don ganin kashi nawa ne na awa ɗaya.

20261121-physics-e6-1.material: Idan aka lura da kallon wuri ko bishiya da ke nesa sosai ta hanyar haska su a kan allo da ruwan tabarau mai tudu (convex lens), wane ne siffar hoton da ke bayyana a allo?
20261121-physics-e6-1.thinking.0: Idan aka lura da kallon wuri
20261121-physics-e6-1.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka lura da kallon wuri ko bishiya da ke nesa sosai ta hanyar haska su a kan allo da ruwan tabarau mai tudu (convex lens), wane ne siffar hoton da ke bayyana a allo?
20261121-physics-e6-1.s.s1.explain: Idan abu yana nesa fiye da tazarar mai da hankali a ruwan tabarau mai tudu, hoton gaske da ya fi ƙanƙanta fiye da na gaske, kuma a juye sama zuwa ƙasa da dama zuwa hagu, yana bayyana a allo.
20261121-physics-e6-1.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunani game da hoton gaske na abu da ke nesa fiye da tazarar mai da hankali a ruwan tabarau mai tudu.
20261121-physics-e6-1.s.s1.hint.1: Haske yana ratsa ruwan tabarau, yana karkata kuma yana taruwa.

20261121-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o1: Hoto da ya fi girma fiye da na gaske kuma a tsaye
20261121-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o2: Hoto mai girma ɗaya da na gaske kuma a tsaye
20261121-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o3: Babu hoto da ke bayyana, sai duhu

20261121-physics-e6-2.title: An nannaɗe wayar enamel sau 100
20261121-physics-e6-2.goal: Apply principles of An nannaɗe wayar enamel sau 100 to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-physics-e6-2.material: An nannaɗe wayar enamel sau 100 a kusar ƙarfe aka haɗa batir aka yi electromagnet. Menene za a yi don wannan electromagnet ya manne da kulli da yawa (ya yi ƙarfi)?
20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.prompt: An nannaɗe wayar enamel sau 100 a kusar ƙarfe aka haɗa batir aka yi electromagnet. Menene za a yi don wannan electromagnet ya manne da kulli da yawa (ya yi ƙarfi)?
20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.explain: Don ƙara ƙarfin electromagnet, dole a ƙara yawan nannaɗen coil, ko a ƙara batir a jere don ƙara ƙarfin wutar lantarki da ke gudana a cikin da'ira.
20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.0: Ƙarfin electromagnet yana daidai da ƙarfin wutar lantarki da yawan nannaɗe na coil.
20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.1: Idan wutar lantarki ta fi ƙarfi, ana samun filin maganaɗisu mai ƙarfi.
20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o0: A ƙara batir a jere don wutar lantarki ta yi ƙarfi
20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o1: A rage yawan nannaɗewar wayar enamel zuwa sau 20
20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o2: A buɗe maɓalli a katse wutar lantarki
20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o3: A cire kusar ƙarfe a sa sandar cin abinci ta itace

20261122-physics-e6-1.title: Idan aka duba haruffan jarida ta
20261122-physics-e6-1.topic: Idan aka duba haruffan jarida ta
20261122-physics-e6-1.goal: Apply principles of Idan aka duba haruffan jarida ta to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e6-1.material: [Aikace-aikace mai zurfi] Idan aka duba haruffan jarida ta gilashin ƙara girma (ruwan tabarau mai tudu) da aka kawo kusa sosai, haruffan suna bayyana manya kuma a tsaye, amma idan aka nesanta shi, haruffan suna bayyana a juye. Menene dalilin da suke bayyana a tsaye idan aka kawo kusa?
20261122-physics-e6-1.thinking.0: Idan aka duba haruffan jarida ta
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.prompt: [Aikace-aikace mai zurfi] Idan aka duba haruffan jarida ta gilashin ƙara girma (ruwan tabarau mai tudu) da aka kawo kusa sosai, haruffan suna bayyana manya kuma a tsaye, amma idan aka nesanta shi, haruffan suna bayyana a juye. Menene dalilin da suke bayyana a tsaye idan aka kawo kusa?
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.explain: Idan abu yana cikin tazarar mai da hankali na ruwan tabarau mai tudu, tsawaitattun layukan hasken da suka karkata suna haɗuwa suna yin hoton ƙarya mai tsayi wanda ya fi abu girma (hoton ƙarya mai girma a tsaye).
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunani game da hanyar haske idan abu yana kusa fiye da tazarar mai da hankali.
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.hint.1: Haske yana bazuwa, don haka sai a zana tsawaitaccen layi a bayan ruwan tabarau don su haɗu.
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o0: Domin haruffan suna cikin tazarar mai da hankali na ruwan tabarau, ana ganin hoton ƙarya (virtual) mai tsayi da girma
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o1: Domin haske ya yi tunani daidai kamar madubi a saman ruwan tabarau
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o2: Domin ido na retina ya ƙara girma na ɗan lokaci
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o3: Domin tururin ruwa a iska ya yi zafi a ruwan tabarau

20261122-physics-e6-2.title: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa
20261122-physics-e6-2.topic: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa
20261122-physics-e6-2.goal: Apply principles of Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e6-2.material: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa ba za a taɓa taɓa filogin wuta ko maɓallin na'urar gida da jikakken hannu ba?
20261122-physics-e6-2.thinking.0: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.prompt: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa ba za a taɓa taɓa filogin wuta ko maɓallin na'urar gida da jikakken hannu ba?
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.explain: Idan fata ta jike da ruwa, juriyar wutar lantarki ta jiki tana raguwa sosai zuwa wani juzu'i na ƙimar al'ada, don haka ko da ƙaramin ƙarfin lantarki, wuta mai kisa tana gudana ta cikin jiki, wanda ke haddasa girgizar wuta.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.0: Ba kamar tsantsar ruwa ba, ruwan yau da kullum yana ɗauke da electrolytes da suka narke.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.1: Jikakken hannu yana rage juriyar fata sosai don haka wutar lantarki tana gudana cikin sauƙi.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o0: Domin ƙwayoyin ion na ma'adinai da ke narkewa a ruwa suna sa wutar lantarki ta wuce cikin sauƙi, haɗarin girgizar wuta yana ƙaruwa sosai
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o1: Domin digon ruwa yana sanyaya filogi ya daskare shi
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o2: Domin ƙarfin maganaɗisu yana faruwa a jikakken hannu
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o3: Domin wutar lantarki tana sa duk ruwan hannu ya ƙafe
